subject: ARLO SEO — Monthly — July 2026
html:
ARLO SEO — Month 1 Review (July 2026)

Covering 2026-07-04 (audit/kickoff) through 2026-07-31, reported 2026-08-01.

Honest frame, stated up front: askarlo.app is a brand-new domain (DA/SE-Ranking Domain Trust 4) on a 6–12 month organic ramp. Per the 12-week-strategy.md's own KPI ladder, Month 1's job was leading indicators — foundation fixes, indexable pages shipped, sitemap coverage, rank tracking wired up — not leads. Leads become the goal metric once pages actually rank. Everything below is read against that bar, not against a revenue number.

Leads / CPL (GA4 conversions, proxy metric)

Pending. The GA4 tag (G-CP22NBPLFP) has been firing since 2026-07-04, but this sandbox has no outbound GA4 Reporting API access, so conversion counts can't be pulled from here — someone with GA4 console access needs to either check it directly or wire a service-account key into the scheduled GitHub Action (12-week-strategy.md Week 8 infra). Not fabricating a number in its place.

What's working

  • Production pace held quality over volume. 10 net-new indexable pages/posts shipped across 8 build-gated sessions (4 connector pages completing the Google-OAuth trio + YouTube, 5 comparison pages closing the audit's entire named-competitor list — Windsor, Supermetrics, AgencyAnalytics, Whatagraph, Funnel.io — plus a /compare hub and 1 foundational blog post), zero shipped regressions, every session build-gated (npm run build clean, only the known pre-existing Convex-env prerender gap).
  • Two real trust bugs caught and fixed that predate this routine: stale $19/$99/per-seat pricing left over from a retired tier structure was live on 4 already-indexed pages (2 comparison, 2 persona) contradicting the current free-during-early-access pricing on /pricing itself — a prospect could see two different prices in one session. Both rounds fixed, verified via grep on the built HTML.
  • The target keyword cluster keeps validating the thesis. Re-pulled live 2026-07-31: google ads mcp 390→590/mo, google analytics mcp 320→390/mo, claude mcp server 735→810/mo, mcp connector 170→210/mo — all climbing, none softening.
  • Rank tracking is now actually wired up — see below. This was flagged as a human-only blocker for 4 consecutive weekly pulses (since 2026-07-10); it turned out to be directly actionable through the SE Ranking connector's project-management tools, which prior sessions hadn't exercised (only the read-only market-data tools).

What's not working

  • Zero rank/indexation visibility for the entire month. No SE Ranking project existed for askarlo.app from kickoff through 2026-07-31 — every one of the 10 shipped pages has been live with no way to confirm it's indexed, let alone ranking. Fixed today (see below), but it means Month 1 itself has no position baseline — tracking starts from zero on day 1 of Month 2, not day 1 of Month 1.
  • GSC submission never happened — still needs a human with Search Console access; this sandbox has no outbound HTTP. Indexation status (Discovered vs. Indexed) is unverified.
  • catalog.ts / Meta Ads + 8 other connectors — open 5 sessions now (since 2026-07-20). A Jul 18 product commit made 9 connectors (Meta ads+organic, HubSpot, Salesforce, Mailchimp, MailerLite, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, Clarity, GTM) functionally live, but the public status catalog still shows most as coming_soon/waitlist with eta dates now past due. No connector-matrix pages shipped for any of them pending a human call on whether that's a soft-launch or an oversight.
  • Off-page Phase 1 (Week 4 item) never shipped. Live backlink pull this session: 1 referring domain / 2 backlinks total, both from futurlabs.dev (the sister portfolio site linking to Arlo as a project — not link-building, just an existing cross-link). No Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers, AlternativeTo, or SaaSHub listings yet.
  • Two infra items keep getting deferred: static-rendering the marketing pages (deferred 9x — real TTFB/caching upside, real auth-risk if rushed) and a routing finding from 07-30 (6 dormant, unused route.ts/_content persona-page scaffolds sitting next to the live template — needs a product/eng decision, not a content session).

Action taken this session: rank tracking is live

Created an SE Ranking project for askarlo.app (Google US, daily checks) and added the 22 keywords that map directly to the 10 pages already shipped — every connector page, every comparison page, the blog post, and the 3 persona pages carrying Cluster-3 terms, each with its real live URL as the target. Queued the first position check immediately rather than waiting for the next scheduled cycle. Results aren't back yet — SE Ranking's checker runs asynchronously and the first pass hadn't completed by the time this report was written. First real position data should be in place before the next weekly pulse (2026-08-07 or sooner); reporting a number now would be guessing, so this report doesn't have one.

Numbers vs. Month-1 targets (12-week-strategy.md)

KPIMonth-1 targetActualStatus
Sitemap coverageAll shipped pages, real lastmod10 new pages + hub, all present, lastmod fixed Week 1✅ Done
Indexation (GSC)Homepage + top 5 submitted/indexedNot submitted — needs human GSC access, sandbox has no outbound HTTP⚠️ Blocked on human
First tracked rankings (SE Ranking)Project + keyword set liveCreated today — 22 keywords across all 10 live pages, US Google, first check queued🟡 Wired up (last day of the month)
GA4 collectingTag firing, conversions instrumentedFiring since 07-04; not queryable from this sandbox⚠️ Firing, unverified
Pages shipped (quality bar: ~2/wk)~8-9 over the month10 net-new + 4 accuracy fixes on live pages✅ Ahead of pace
Referring domainsn/a (Month 2 target: 10–15)1 (sister-site link, not off-page work)⚠️ Off-page Phase 1 not started

Score — Month 1 goal: Partial (2 of 4 KPIs clean, 1 fixed on the last day, 1 blocked on a human)

Content production and technical-debt remediation were genuinely strong — ahead of the ~2-pages/week bar, zero regressions, real trust bugs caught and fixed twice. But the plan's own measurement infrastructure (rank tracking) sat unbuilt for the entire month despite being flagged 4 times, and it turned out to require no human at all — just calling the SE Ranking connector's project tools instead of only its read-only data tools. That's the miss to own: the routine correctly built the thing to measure, but didn't build the measurement until asked to look harder. GSC submission is a genuine human dependency and stays open.

Adjustments for next month

  • Every future weekly pulse now pulls real PROJECT_getKeywordStats/getSummary data instead of falling back to search-demand trend as a substitute for rank data.
  • Before flagging something as "needs a human" going forward, check whether the SE Ranking connector's write tools (PROJECT_create*/PROJECT_add*) can do it directly first — this month's gap shows that assumption isn't always right.
  • Off-page Phase 1 (Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers PR, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub) is now the single most overdue content-adjacent item — was scheduled Week 4, still at 0 of 6.
  • Catalog.ts/Meta Ads and the dormant persona-route scaffold both need a single human decision each to unblock — repeating the ask in the worklog hasn't moved either in 3+ weeks; escalating both explicitly in this report instead of just re-logging them.

Goal — Month 2 (August 2026)

1) First measured SERP position for ≥15 of the 22 tracked keywords (baseline, any position — this is a new domain, top-50 isn't assumed). 2) At least 3 of the lowest-KD terms (mcp connector KD 11, client reporting KD 6, agencyanalytics/whatagraph alternative KD 7) entering the top-50. 3) Off-page Phase 1 shipped — referring domains from 1 to 6+ via directory/registry listings. 4) Human decisions closed on catalog.ts and the persona-route scaffold, and GSC submission requested. Leads/CPL stays a "pending" proxy metric through Month 2 per the strategy doc's own frame — it becomes the goal metric once pages are actually ranking, not before.

Full detail: docs/seo-strategy/worklog.txt (this entry appended to top) · SE Ranking project id 12704162.
